Australia’s crypto licensing deadline is September 30.  
  
ASIC says qualifying digital asset firms must apply for or vary a license, become an authorized representative, notify the regulator of an intended market-license application or begin winding down.  
  
The deadline does not apply to every crypto business. Whether a firm needs authorization depends on whether its digital asset or arrangement qualifies as a financial product and what services it provides.

Liquid Network has reported a security incident involving the withdrawal of approximately **4,000 BTC worth $320 million** from its Federation wallet.  
  
The Bitcoin sidechain has been temporarily paused while Blockstream and federation members investigate and work to restore normal activity.  
  
The white-hat hacker is now communicating with network maintainers on-chain and says the BTC will be returned once the vulnerability is fixed, although the funds have not been returned yet.
